purpose: Continue the offline three-session iteration engine after terminal Campaign287 with one finite nonlinear similarity trial over the complete already-exposed Alpha158 design. The trial uses a fixed session-ordinal map, a fixed random Fourier approximation to one RBF kernel and one closed-form ridge output; it does not retune Campaign287, reopen tree or raw-linear families, select Alpha158 components, or open the 2024-2025 lockbox.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_alpha158_session_ordinal_fixed_rbf_random_fourier_ridge
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The fixed cross-sectional percentile map removes raw scale and outlier dependence, while the fixed cosine map approximates one RBF similarity geometry. Only the output coefficients see returns. This is distinct from Campaign286 tree partitions and Campaign287's jointly trained raw-feature ReLU representation. The result remains exploratory because Alpha158 values and earlier walk-forward returns are already exposed.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: random_fourier_dimension_bandwidth_phase_seed_or_penalty_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Searching the kernel approximation or ridge strength after prior results would create a new hyperparameter grid. Campaign288 permits exactly 128 fixed cosine features, one analytical bandwidth, one seed and one penalty.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: raw_alpha158_linear_ridge_lasso_elastic_net_or_simplex_refit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102 consumed bounded-simplex ridge and Campaign132 closed refreshed signed-linear and sparse-weight families. Campaign288 does not fit a linear model in the raw Alpha158 coordinates.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign287_mlp_width_depth_epoch_seed_preprocessing_or_cost_repair
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign287 is immutable and terminal. Its positive associations but failed drawdown and 20bp economics cannot be repaired by an architecture, seed, training or threshold refresh.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign286_tree_ensemble_or_threshold_retry
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign286 already terminalized the complete-Alpha158 boosted-tree baseline; forests, boosting variants and split-parameter repairs remain closed.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_feature_subset_missing_indicator_or_group_selection
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Result-driven component selection would violate the complete finite feature-library boundary and multiply attempts. Every Alpha158 coordinate remains in the fixed kernel map in frozen order.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: nystrom_anchor_selection_exact_kernel_svr_or_gaussian_process
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Anchor selection, support-vector regularization and exact kernel solvers introduce data-dependent basis or solver choices beyond the one fixed bounded approximation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha360_new_feature_snapshot_on_current_writable_volume
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The authorized writable system volume still lacks comfortable capacity for another five-year dense feature snapshot. This remains an infrastructure deferral, not a scientific rejection.

selected_family.feature_library: all 158 Campaign286 Alpha158 features in frozen order
selected_family.input_map: within each signal session and each feature, ascending average-tie percentile among finite model-support names minus 0.5; missing maps to neutral zero
selected_family.kernel_approximation: 128 deterministic random Fourier cosine coordinates for one RBF kernel
selected_family.analytical_rbf_gamma: 6/158, chosen before values because two independent centered Uniform(-0.5,0.5) ranks have expected squared distance 1/6 per coordinate, making the 158-coordinate expected kernel exponent approximately one
selected_family.output_model: one closed-form session-weighted ridge regression with centered target and no intercept
selected_family.training_session_balance: deterministically select exactly 96 names per contained training signal session before reading training returns; finite sampled targets receive equal total loss mass per retained session

historical_exposure_classification.campaign288_allowed_role: exploratory historical model trial under the user-frozen walk-forward policy
